description: Sixteen-band vocoder — the modulator's band levels are traced and printed onto the carrier

params.text: Sets how much of that band of the carrier reaches the output, silent at one end and four times at the other
Sets how fast the band follower climbs when the modulator gets louder, instant at one end and a quarter of a second at the other
Sets how fast the band follower falls back when the modulator gets quieter, instant at one end and a quarter of a second at the other
Sets the resonance of every band filter, on the modulator side and the carrier side alike, 1 to 10
This knob does nothing in this version — every band filter takes its resonance from the first Q knob
Sets the gain the modulator is given before it is analysed, 1 to 10
Sets the gain the carrier is given before it is filtered, 1 to 10

inputs.text: The signal whose band levels are traced, usually a voice
The signal the traced band levels are printed onto, usually something rich in harmonics

outputs.text: The carrier with the modulator's band levels on it
